title: Why Slow Drains Happen: Identifying the Root Cause
description: A slow-draining sink or tub is often the first warning sign of a developing blockage within your drainage system. Rather than reaching immediately for harsh chemical drain cleaners, professional plumbers look for patterns to diagnose the exact cause. Hair, soap scum, and grease gradually accumulate along the interior walls of the pipe, narrowing the internal diameter and restricting wastewater flow. Understanding where and why these accumulations form helps you apply the correct mechanical clearing method, such as using a drum auger or clearing the trap, protecting both the plumbing fixtures and your safety.

Why Slow Drains Happen: Identifying the Root Cause

A slow-draining sink or tub is often the first warning sign of a developing blockage within your drainage system. Rather than reaching immediately for harsh chemical drain cleaners, professional plumbers look for patterns to diagnose the exact cause. Hair, soap scum, and grease gradually accumulate along the interior walls of the pipe, narrowing the internal diameter and restricting wastewater flow. Understanding where and why these accumulations form helps you apply the correct mechanical clearing method, such as using a drum auger or clearing the trap, protecting both the plumbing fixtures and your safety.
